title: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer

entities.name: Tam
entities.description: A Quandrix student at Strixhaven whose hair levitates and writhes when she is stirred up; she is trapped with her friends deep in Titan's Grave and keeps seeing a man in white in reflections.

entities.name: Lluwen
entities.description: A young elf student and former scout from Lorwyn who leads the group out of the chamber, but grows prideful and is seized by a daemogoth.

entities.name: Kirol
entities.description: A bulky, stubborn vampire student and Lluwen's devoted friend, who refuses to leave him behind.

entities.name: Sanar
entities.description: A student who drums beats to boost morale and works on a metronome clock with Suki.

entities.name: Abigale
entities.description: An owlin student who signs rather than speaks, scouts above the group, and takes notes.

entities.name: Suki
entities.description: A stiff, stone-voiced young woman of the Shattered who leads their excavation and joins the students' group.

entities.name: Professor Fel
entities.description: A Strixhaven professor and planeswalker who kills the daemogoth with a surge of plant life and reveals he is trying to keep a promise.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker, frustrated and in pain, who believes Jace is plotting to use the huge archaic and wants it killed.

entities.name: Ajani
entities.description: Chandra's old friend, a planeswalker with Phyrexian plates of red and white, who doubts her but agrees to support her.

entities.name: Jace
entities.description: A figure Chandra believes has taken a dark turn and plans to incarnate into the huge archaic.

entities.name: Nissa
entities.description: A friend who stayed at Chandra's side through her recovery.

entities.name: Wrenn
entities.description: A tree-coaxing friend of Chandra's, contrasted with her blunt methods.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: Someone whose memories Chandra now carries; she does not want Ajani to learn how much she knows about her.

entities.name: Oracle Jadzi
entities.description: An oracle carried off by the huge archaic, who told Tam about Fel's past.

entities.name: Professor Vess
entities.description: A professor about whom Lluwen has heard stories of planeswalker power.

entities.name: The Daemogoth
entities.description: A demon of Arcavios that feeds on negative emotions, lurks in Titan's Grave and attacks the students.

entities.name: Lumarets
entities.description: Small luminescent forest creatures that lead Lluwen's group through the tunnels and flee before the daemogoth.

entities.name: The Huge Archaic
entities.description: A gigantic archaic carrying Jadzi, which Chandra believes Jace plans to incarnate into.

entities.name: Titan's Grave
entities.description: A place on Arcavios named for a titan's spine and ribs, with tunnels lined by buried bone arches.

entities.name: The Shattered
entities.description: Chandra's students, a cohort who ambushed the group and now dig alongside it.

entities.name: The Oriq
entities.description: A group Tam calls a plague upon the school.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: The plane where Strixhaven stands.

entities.name: Lorwyn
entities.description: Lluwen's home, where he was a scout.

events.summary: Tam wakes beneath the earth after the archaic's attack; Kirol is hurling boughs off trapped students and Sanar and Abigale are helping.
events.quote: That bulky frame hurling boughs off the trapped students could only be Kirol.

events.summary: Lluwen tells Tam they are in Titan's Grave, deeper than any records go.
events.quote: "In Titan's Grave. Deeper than we have any records of going, if we can trust the Shattered."

events.summary: Tam asks Suki to join the group, and the Shattered come over to share what they know.
events.quote: "Come join us," said Tam.

events.summary: Abigale reports at least two dozen ways out of the chamber.
events.quote: But there are at least two dozen ways out of here, maybe more.

events.summary: Lluwen volunteers to scout a path out, and Suki insists he take someone with him; Kirol claims the job.
events.quote: "It's best if you have someone with you.

events.summary: Lluwen is moved that Kirol would talk to their family for him; Kirol is stung when Lluwen changes the subject.
events.quote: "Well, yeah. But I would for you."

events.summary: Lluwen finds the lumarets and believes they will lead the way out.
events.quote: "I think I found our way out of here."

events.summary: Back at camp Tam frets over being left behind while Sanar and Suki build a metronome clock.
events.quote: Sanar and Suki were working on a metronome-based clock.

events.summary: Fetching water, Tam sees a man in white in the reflection until Lluwen's shout breaks the moment.
events.quote: It was a man in white.

events.summary: Lluwen leads the group through the tunnels behind the lumarets, growing proud.
events.quote: The young elf strode proud down the twisting, impossible hallways.

events.summary: A strange feeling of dread spreads through the group and tempers flare; Lluwen snaps at Tam and Kirol.
events.quote: "You're the one who brought up the tension.

events.summary: The lumarets flee and the tunnel begins to shake as a daemogoth reveals itself.
events.quote: "I thought I'd have longer for you to ripen."

events.summary: The tunnel turns against the students and roots seize Lluwen, threatening to drag him into the earth while his friends pull him back.
events.quote: Vines wrapped around Lluwen's ankles and threatened to pull him into the earth.

events.summary: Kirol promises not to leave Lluwen behind.
events.quote: "I'm not going to leave you behind, Lulu!"

events.summary: Professor Fel arrives, and the daemogoth greets him by name and asks about a deal.
events.quote: "Dellian. Have you returned to make that deal with me?"

events.summary: Fel's magic floods the pit with flowers and fungi that grow through the daemogoth and burst its skull, killing it.
events.quote: The daemogoth screamed in the moment before glorious life sprang from its head, bursting its skull.

events.summary: Lluwen asks Fel whether he made a deal with the daemogoth, and Fel dismisses it.
events.quote: "With that provincial bogeyman? Ridiculous. It has nothing to offer me."

events.summary: Fel says he has been trying to find a way to keep an old promise, and Tam reveals she knows he sought to save the woman he loved, from Jadzi.
events.quote: You wanted to try and find some way to go back and save the woman you loved."

events.summary: Fel says the last he saw of the huge archaic it was carrying Jadzi nearby, and leads the group toward the exit.
events.quote: The last we saw of that huge archaic, it was carrying Jadzi not far from here.

events.summary: Lluwen tells Fel he saw archaics gathered around a snarl, and Fel says there are no snarls in Titan's Grave and asks to be taken there.
events.quote: "There are no snarls in Titan's Grave. There never have been,"

events.summary: Elsewhere in the tunnels, Chandra and Ajani argue; she tells Ajani she believes Jace plans to use the huge archaic.
events.quote: "I think it's the archaic. The big one."

events.summary: Chandra asks Ajani to help her find and kill the huge archaic before Jace can use it, and he agrees to support her.
events.quote: "I'll support you, Chandra.

relations.note: Kirol calls themself Lluwen's chum and refuses to leave him behind.
Fel kills the daemogoth that attacked the students.
relations.quote: The daemogoth screamed in the moment before glorious life sprang from its head, bursting its skull.

relations.note: Old friends, though strained by his disbelief.
relations.quote: Chandra didn't know what to expect from her old friend anymore.

relations.note: Suki leads the Shattered cohort digging out the students.
relations.quote: Suki and the other Shattered came over to join the group.

relations.note: The lumarets live in the tunnels and lead Lluwen through them.
relations.quote: There were six of them by Lluwen's count, all balanced along a bramble behind Kirol.
